name: Azure File Sync + Azure Backup
summary: Assess, design, build, connect and prove Azure File Sync with Azure Backup over private endpoints, from one PowerShell menu (start.ps1). The assessment is read-only and runs offline against an export, with a read-back proof for everything the build creates.

tools.label: Wizard
tools.description: The 14-option menu: learn, check requirements, assess, build, connect servers, prove, remove.

tools.label: Offline tests
tools.description: Proves this copy of the kit is intact; no Azure account needed. Run python fixtures\make-fixture.py first.

tools.label: Assess an export
tools.description: Applies the assessment rules offline to an export and writes the HTML report; -ExportPath, -OutputPath.

tools.label: Export an environment
tools.description: Read-only export of File Sync, storage, Backup, private endpoints and DNS (Reader is enough).

tools.label: Server diagnostics
tools.description: Per-file-server bundle; run elevated on each file server.

tools.label: Governance assessment
tools.description: Tenant policy and RBAC report through the Azure Governance Visualizer.

prerequisites: Windows PowerShell 5.1 (powershell.exe), not Git Bash; Git and Python 3
Azure CLI for anything beyond the offline assessment
Reader on the estate for an export; build rights on the target subscription for a build
RSAT AD and DNS modules, installed once elevated, for the on-premises steps
A network path from on-premises into the new VNet (ExpressRoute or VPN) that you provide
claudePrompt: Read README.md and docs/USER-GUIDE.md first. Help me run the offline tests and assess the synthetic estate, then assess my own export or plan a build with the advise guides, explaining every finding and every phase's dry run. Stop and ask before any step that re-images, wipes, reboots, deletes or changes a server or Azure resource.
